label: Stripe revenue
description: MRR, active subscriptions and the last 30 days of revenue from Stripe. Read-only: use a restricted key.

metrics.name: MRR (Stripe)
metrics.definition: Active subscriptions normalised to a month (yearly / 12, weekly x 4.33). In your Stripe currency, before tax. Excludes one-time charges.

metrics.name: Revenue, last 30 days (Stripe)
metrics.definition: Successful charges in the last 30 days minus refunds, in your Stripe currency.
